# IT SmartFlex - AI Hub & Enterprise AI Solutions

> IT SmartFlex AI Hub is an enterprise solution showcase demonstrating practical AI applications: Generative AI, RAG Knowledge Bases, Voice & Support AI Bots, Document Intelligence (Doc AI), Copilot Dev Productivity, Business Analytics, and Computer Vision Robotics.

## Main Resources

- [AI Hub Home](https://ai-hub-webpage-358601432150.europe-west1.run.app/): Overview of IT SmartFlex AI capabilities, enterprise AI products, and practical application scenarios.
- [AI Solutions Catalog](https://ai-hub-webpage-358601432150.europe-west1.run.app/catalog/): Catalog of Business Cases and Use Cases implemented by the IT SmartFlex AI Unit.
- [Case Studies Overview](https://ai-hub-webpage-358601432150.europe-west1.run.app/cases/): All 6 real-world enterprise case studies with metrics, technical architecture, and business outcomes.
- [Full LLM Context](https://ai-hub-webpage-358601432150.europe-west1.run.app/llms-full.txt): Complete detailed text file containing technical specifications, AI product architectures, and case studies for LLM retrieval.

## Core Case Studies Showcase

1. **Customer Support AI Bot**: 24/7 AI-powered support bot with automated incident escalation, multi-language speech-to-text, and SLA reduction down to < 15 sec.
2. **Doc AI Document Intelligence**: Automated OCR, entity extraction, and compliance checking for legal contracts, invoices, and logistics documentation.
3. **RAG Enterprise Knowledge Base**: Semantic vector search (Qdrant) across corporate Confluence, SharePoint, and technical documentation with source attribution.
4. **Copilot Dev Productivity**: AI assistant for automated code review, unit test generation, and pull request analysis integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
5. **Business Analytics & Predictive AI**: Automated BI dashboard generation, anomaly detection, and predictive infrastructure metrics.
6. **Robotics & Computer Vision**: Edge AI computer vision for quality control, defect detection on production lines, and robotic automation.
